text: Hebr. vpon the face of the earth.
Hebr. that the reuenger of blood doe not multiply to destroy.
Or, because God hath not taken away his life, he hath also deuised meanes, &c.
Hebr. for rest. , Hebr. to heare.
Heb. and as Absalom there was not a beautifull man in all Israel, to praise greatly.
